status_definitions.PROVEN_EXACT: Every binding gate requirement is integrated on evaluated_main_sha and has exact-main executable evidence, including a user-reachable Product Journey where the gate depends on product composition.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: A material subset is integrated and exact-main evidence exists, but one or more binding requirements or user-reachable composition steps are absent or unproven.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: The gate has integrated capability, but a known exact-main defect, unmet authority/governance dependency, or required unintegrated repair prevents acceptance.
status_definitions.NOT_INTEGRATED: The gate-critical production capability is absent from evaluated_main_sha; candidate or QA-only code receives no integration credit.
